scripts.sync-frontend: node -e "const fs=require('fs'), cp=require('child_process'); cp.execSync('pnpm --dir ../frontend install', {stdio:'inherit'}); cp.execSync('pnpm --dir ../frontend run build', {stdio:'inherit'}); if (fs.existsSync('../frontend/dist')) { if (fs.existsSync('public/assets')) { fs.rmSync('public/assets', {recursive:true, force:true}); } fs.mkdirSync('public', {recursive:true}); fs.cpSync('../frontend/dist', 'public', {recursive:true}); }"
scripts.build: pnpm run sync-frontend && pnpm run sync-admin
